'**Lightning Flow** - If you've played a Lightning card this turn, this gets +1{p}.'

The Flow keyword itself is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored here (triage note: 'Flow fires from the DB keywords field, no authoring').

Release notes settle the ability type: 'Whether you've played a Lightning card this turn is checked while this is attacking on the combat chain' and a Lightning card played before damage calculation still counts - the condition is ALWAYS CHECKING during the attack, so this is a static re-evaluated on RECALC_ATTACK_POWER (WHILE_STATIC), not a triggered ON_ATTACK check frozen at declaration. This is the Aggressive Pounce lesson: always-checking means static.

Shape is shipped pen/savage_claw.json (the documented WHILE_STATIC power-conditional): conditions gate it, MODIFY_ATTACK add 1 lands in the stage-8 static window so it is never double-applied. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK keeps the buff on Crackling's own attack only.

The condition: play.py (~1085) records every played card's slug/name/types/subtypes/classes/TALENTS/colour as turn-event qualifiers via _record_turn_event; record_turn_event_for_player writes one marker per normalised identity (_norm_ident strips non-alnum + lowercases, so talent 'Lightning' -> did_this_turn:play:lightning), and EVENT_THIS_TURN folds its qualifier identically - so qualifier 'lightning' matches any played card with the Lightning talent. Verified end to end in condition_types.py:1070-1112 and effect_keywords.py:575-606.

Note: play.py (~1066) ALSO hand-rolls a 'played_lightning' flag that several shipped cards gate on via FLAG_SET. Both are written by the same play path from the same fields, so they agree; I chose the canonical EVENT_THIS_TURN route per the triage note rather than copying the legacy flag spelling.
